name: Ever Ohms Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ever Ohms Technology Co.,Ltd. operates internationally, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and global sale of electronic components. The company's primary offerings include a wide array of chip resistors and resistor networks. Additionally, its comprehensive product range encompasses thick film and thin film resistors, various arrays, metal film, metal strip, metal foil, and metal shunt resistors, as well as specialized components for automotive applications, fusible resistors, and MELF (Metal Electrode Leadless Face) resistors. These essential components are utilized across diverse industries such as automotive, power and energy, computing, mobile technology, and telecommunications. Founded in 1988, the firm's main office is situated in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
